Got a take out here recently. The staff was accommodating and very friendly. I forgot what cheesecake I got it was so good. The matcha is kinda more on the milk side but I still enjoyed it nevertheless. The atmosphere of the place is great for catching with friends and all. I'll be sure to be back next time.

The interior design has an industrial feel but the chairs are comfortable enough for long hours of sitting and noise doesn't travel as much so this place is conducive for studying. However their drinks could be so much better. I haven't tasted a single drink here that tastes good (been here twice) and so does all the people I know. I appreciate that the barista let me know that their matcha is bitter when I ordered their latte but that also means they already know they need to improve, here's to hoping they're already working on it.
